# Mill replacement artwork

- `mill.png`: large watermill backdrop, displayed behind the playable lane at x4500–5200.
- `mill_floor.png`: separate loading deck, fitted to the solid platform x4720–5010, lane depth 78, height 70. Transparent export padding is excluded by its Phaser texture frame. The building itself adds no invisible collision.

Created using the imagegen skill and built-in image generation, with the existing village barn as the style reference. Original generated files were preserved.

Building prompt: A large medieval Nordic watermill, isolated transparent background, gritty hand-painted dark fantasy matching the burning village barn. Charred timber, stone foundation, straw roof, restrained orange ember lighting. Front elevation for a side-scrolling beat-em-up, massive wooden waterwheel left, two-storey mill right, open loading doorway and flour sacks. Entire building visible, straight ground baseline, no street, foreground obstacles, people or text.

Deck prompt: Only a wide low rectangular medieval loading platform, isolated transparent background. Charred oak boards, heavy timber beams and low weathered stone foundation, gritty hand-painted style matching the barn. Broad unobstructed top receding upward, straight front edge, no rails, stairs, sacks, people or lettering. Warm oak and ash-grey stone with reflected firelight.

Test: open TEST SCENES (F8), choose Mill yard / Brother Cinder. Other shortcuts include Hakon & Oathkeeper and Raised-sword reveal. Test jumps clone campaign progress into memory; they do not write to the campaign save.
